messages:
alex (partnerships): Quick sync: Harmonix wants to ship their identity connector to our marketplace. Scope: SAML (SP+IdP flows), SCIM provisioning (PATCH + bulk import), and HSM-backed key-wrap for secrets. Can we split owners and list blockers?

ajay (security): I can own the KMS/HSM validation and threat-model. Need attestation PDF, wrap/unwrap endpoint spec, supported algs (RSA-OAEP / AES-GCM / AES-KW), and a test wrap key we can call read-only. Also request exposure of unwrap audit events.

priya (product): I'll own marketplace listing + install UX. Need a short (<=140 char) blurb, long blurb, tags (SAML, SCIM, KMS), logo (SVG + PNG), and one admin screenshot. Also confirm supported provisioning modes and SCIM PATCH semantics.

rui (eng): I'll take SAML runtime tests and SCIM smoke checks. Please send IdP metadata, sample SAML assertions, ACS URLs, and sample SCIM error payloads (esp 429). Quick SCIM sample we9ll use:
POST /scim/v2/Users
Content-Type: application/scim+json
{ "userName": "h.jones", "displayName": "H Jones", "emails": [{"value":"h.jones@harmonix.com"}] }

harmonix-sales: We can deliver IdP metadata, SCIM sandbox creds, attestation PDF, and logo by Tue EOD. Embargo target: Jul 12 09:00 PT.

ajay (security): For a quick wrap smoke test ask them to run and paste output (base64):
curl -sS -X POST https://sandbox.harmonix.com/kms/wrap 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"key_id":"test-wrap","plaintext":"VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3Q="}'
We9ll verify unwrap returns original plaintext and check wrapped metadata headers.

samir (legal): We'll need logo/trademark approvals and their draft DPA if the sandbox contains customer PII. Also confirm embargo/legal copy for co-marketing.

alex (partnerships): Action items recap:
- Harmonix -> send IdP metadata, SCIM creds, attestation, logo, DPA draft by Tue EOD.
- ajay -> schedule 30m threat-model after attestation (target Wed).
- rui -> add SAML+SCIM smoke tests to partner CI (toggleable).
- priya -> draft marketplace blurbs once screenshot arrives.

release-bot: draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integrations/pull/1102 (placeholder listing + install guide stub).

harmonix-sales: Confirmed, we'll ship artifacts by Tue. Thanks team.

alex (partnerships): Thanks everyone 94 I9ll send invites and a short agenda. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
